name: Eole Workspace - Chat, Translate and OCR
readme: Eole workspace with Qwen3.8-27B Chat, Tencent Hy-MT2-7B translation and DeepSeek-OCR documents. Create a private eole_password RunPod Secret with at least 16 characters. EOLE_QWEN_VARIANT selects int4 (default, >=32 GB GPU), bf16 (original Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B, >=80 GB GPU; 96 GB recommended), or both (both Qwen models in the selector). Use an x86 host with CUDA 13.2 driver support and the recommended 250 GB volume; keep HF sources and converted weights on /workspace. Open Connect > HTTP port 5000 and sign in as eole. Preparation downloads/converts all selected models. Switching workspaces unloads the previous GPU model and loads the selected one; first use compiles inference. RTX PRO 6000 tested with INT4 Chat; multi-model/BF16 cloud validation is pending. Grace ARM hosts are unsupported. No SSH service is installed. Compute/storage charges apply. See https://github.com/eole-nlp/eole/tree/main/recipes/runpod
